title: Geometric irreducibility spreads for a generically integral hypersurface
statement: Let S be an integral affine scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], \eta a generic point of S, A=\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S), n\in\mathbf N, and P\in A[t_1,\ldots,t_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Set H=\operatorname{Spec}(A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(P)) [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let g:H\to S be induced by the coefficient inclusion and the canonical affine identification S\cong\operatorname{Spec}A. If H_\eta [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], then there is an open U\subseteq S containing \eta such that H_s is geometrically irreducible for every s\in U.

source.place: Tag 0557, lemma-irreducible-polynomial; scheme interpretation of its polynomial specialization statement

proof.text: Use the hypersurface fibre prime criterion to turn the generic geometric irreducibility and reducedness into primality of the defining ideal over every extension field of kappa(eta). If P = 0, every specialized ideal is zero in a polynomial ring over a field and is prime. The same criterion makes every fibre geometrically irreducible, so the whole base works.

For P nonzero, global evaluation at eta is injective: a section vanishing there has basic open avoiding eta, and genericity forces that open empty; reducedness makes the section zero. The coefficient map into an algebraic closure of kappa(eta) is therefore injective and preserves P nonzero. The prime principal ideal gives a prime polynomial and hence an irreducible polynomial. Apply absolute irreducibility specialization to obtain a nonzero a in Gamma(S, top).

Take U = S.basicOpen a. It is nonempty since a is nonzero and S is reduced, and hence contains eta by genericity. For any s in U and any residue field embedding phi into a field K, evaluation of a at s is nonzero, and phi is injective, so the specialization theorem gives an irreducible polynomial in K[t]. The polynomial ring is a UFD, so this polynomial is prime and its principal ideal is prime. Apply the fibre prime criterion and project to geometric irreducibility. This is a complete Lean proof; the polynomial specialization theorem is the only remaining hole.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_generic_hypersurface_geometric_irreducibility
    {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤))
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) :
    let H := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤) ⧸ Ideal.span {P}))
    let g : H ⟶ S := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P})).comp MvPolynomial.C)) ≫ S.isoSpec.inv
    GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) →
      GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) →
      ∃ U : S.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
        ∀ s, s ∈ U → GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s)
